state_rules.CLAIM_TRANSPORT_DEGRADED: claim_transport_blocked_count > 0; count CURRENT/recent unresolved pressure only, never historical terminal blocks indefinitely
state_rules.RETURNS_UNCONSUMED: unconsumed_returns_count > 0 && live_worker_count > 0; without a live consumer, do not suppress REFILL_N
state_rules.RECOVERY_PRESSURE: recovery_attention_count > 0 && live_worker_count > 0; without a live consumer, do not suppress REFILL_N

human_boundary_wait.starts_only_on: explicit durable state requiring one specific human action

aggregation_rules.human_interventions: count durable HUMAN_MESSAGE_DURABLE/HUMAN_AUDIO_DURABLE actions that materially alter work or satisfy an explicit boundary; do not count passive viewing
aggregation_rules.capacity_launch_actions: count durable human launches whose explicit purpose is capacity creation
aggregation_rules.human_routing_actions: count durable human actions that manually select worker routing/task ownership; target zero
aggregation_rules.intents_completed_without_followup_routi: count intents whose visible result occurs without any human routing action after intent materialization
aggregation_rules.consumed_productive_returns: count productive RETURN records consumed by a durable integration disposition
aggregation_rules.successors_created_and_claimed: count successor jobs with both durable creation and subsequent claim evidence
aggregation_rules.latencies: derive only when both endpoint timestamps exist; missing endpoints remain unknown and are excluded from percentiles rather than coerced to zero
aggregation_rules.human_boundary_wait_minutes: sum only intervals opened by an explicit durable human-decision/action boundary and closed by satisfying action or boundary disappearance
aggregation_rules.claim_transport_blocks: count explicit current-period CLAIM_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED outcomes, preserving terminal/history distinction
aggregation_rules.planner_gate_compliance_ratio: eligible planner decisions with durable gate evidence / eligible planner decisions; unknown if denominator cannot be derived
aggregation_rules.reserve_work_consumed_ratio: durably consumed reserve work / durably materialized reserve work; unknown if denominator cannot be derived

daily_projection.privacy: counts, durations and durable refs only; never raw/private transcript, audio, credentials or hidden reasoning

execution_depth_taxonomy.SINGLE_SHOT_SYNTHESIS: one synthesis result; no claim that multiple bots/workers ran
execution_depth_taxonomy.MULTI_DOT_CONTINUATION: multiple explicit continuation steps in one worker/session; report actual durable steps separately from model passes
execution_depth_taxonomy.INTERNAL_MULTI_PASS_SYNTHESIS: multiple internal synthesis passes; never report them as workers
execution_depth_taxonomy.BOT_CARDS_PRODUCED_BUT_NOT_RUN: recommended/generated bot cards exist without durable worker returns
execution_depth_taxonomy.REAL_BOT_RETURNS_SYNTHESIZED: two or more independently durable bot/worker returns were actually received and synthesized
execution_depth_taxonomy.RECOVERY_OR_PARTIAL_RUN: run resumed/recovered or only partially executed; report missing expected work explicitly

templates.PROJECTION_STALE: ACCIÓN: ninguna · proyección desactualizada; no lances capacidad a ciegas.
templates.HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED: Decisión humana requerida · seguí la decisión concreta indicada arriba.
templates.CLAIM_TRANSPORT_DEGRADED: ACCIÓN: ninguna · claim transport degradado; recovery/owner decide reintento.
templates.RECOVERY_PRESSURE: ACCIÓN: ninguna · recovery pendiente; CURRENT/owner compatible lo toma.
templates.BUFFER_LOW: ACCIÓN: ninguna · buffer bajo, pero core cubierto.

missing_telemetry_boundaries.FIRST_MATERIAL_WRITE: may be absent in legacy work; must remain UNKNOWN unless a durable timestamp exists
missing_telemetry_boundaries.FANIN_STARTED: may be absent where integration is represented only by a receipt timestamp; do not synthesize an earlier start
missing_telemetry_boundaries.JUDGED: only available when an explicit Judge/verification record exists
missing_telemetry_boundaries.provider_compute_depth: not derivable from worker counts or UI bot cards; never infer
missing_telemetry_boundaries.model_internal_passes: private/internal unless an observable product exposes a sanctioned aggregate; never reconstruct hidden reasoning

privacy: Raw/private audio and transcript remain in private ingress/storage; public projection receives sanitized references and derived state only.
